hypothesis.statement: On a real overnight EEG (Sleep-EDF SC4001, Fpz-Cz), the Lempel-Ziv complexity of the cortex is LOWEST in deep sleep (N3) and higher in wake and REM -- the consciousness/complexity gradient -- and eegComplexity's Lempel-Ziv measure reproduces the canonical Python antropy.lziv_complexity to machine precision.

analysis_plan.dataset: Sleep-EDF Expanded (PhysioNet sleep-edfx), subject SC4001, EEG Fpz-Cz at 100 Hz; 60-s fixed-length concatenated EEG for each stage (Wake / N2 / N3 / REM) from the expert hypnogram

decision.threshold: descriptive: LZ complexity is lowest in deep sleep N3 (wake - N3 > 0), and the op equals antropy.lziv_complexity to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9)
